instruction: Apply the Noir Gold design system to all frontend surfaces. Change only visual design — colors, typography, spacing, borders, layout composition, and component styling. Do NOT change any logic, routing, state management, API calls, socket connections, authentication flow, or data models. All existing content, copy, and functional behavior must remain identical.

design_system.name: Noir Gold
design_system.philosophy: Dark-ground editorial luxury. Premium broadcast energy — closer to F1, DAZN, UEFA than a SaaS landing page. Contrast and spatial restraint over decoration. Borders only, no box shadows.

pitch_black.role: Primary background, hero surface, auth backgrounds

carbon.role: Section alternates, card surfaces, sidebar, admin panels

gunmetal.role: Borders, dividers, input backgrounds, nav separators

iron.role: Table row dividers, subtle internal separators

linen.role: Primary text, headlines, form labels, nav links

ash.role: Muted labels, secondary copy, placeholder text, sidebar secondary nav

ghost.role: Disabled states, read items, inactive borders, deep muted text

champagne_gold.role: Primary accent — CTAs, active nav, featured card border, highlights, gold stat card, current day chart bar, unread email dot, focus rings, role toggle active state

stadium_green.role: Live/online states, positive deltas, feature checklist icons, send button, system online chip, user online dot

signal_red.role: Errors, inline validation, unread badge on sidebar nav items, negative deltas

display.usage: Hero headlines, section stat numbers, pricing amounts, auth left-panel taglines, final CTA headline

ui.usage: Nav links, subheadings, body copy, form labels, CTAs, buttons, admin sidebar, table cells, badges
ui.weights: 400 body, 500 subheads and labels, 600 buttons and CTAs

mono.usage: Live match ticker, score display, match metadata, monospace data fields

spacing.section_vertical_padding: 80px to 120px — generous empty space is the luxury signal
spacing.border_weight: 1px solid #2A2A26 for structural borders, 0.5px for internal separators

design_system.shadows: NONE — use borders only. No box-shadow anywhere in the design.
design_system.section_alternation: Alternate full-bleed #0D0D0D and #161614 between sections. Do NOT use the same background for more than two consecutive sections.

motion.stat_counters: Count up on viewport enter — one animation per section max
motion.headline_reveal: Left-to-right character reveal on hero load
motion.rule: No parallax on every element. One ambient motion per section maximum.

css_variables.comment: Add these to :root in index.css, replacing existing variables

marketing_homepage.file: src/App.jsx and all marketing section components
global_rules: All section backgrounds alternate between #0D0D0D and #161614
No card shadows — border only: 1px solid #2A2A26

Nav.default_state: background: transparent, position: absolute over hero
Nav.scrolled_state: background: #0D0D0D, border-bottom: 1px solid #2A2A26, position: sticky top-0
Nav.logo: font-family: Inter 700, letter-spacing: 0.1em, text-transform: uppercase, color: #F0EBE1 — 'Kick' + 'Stream'
Nav.links: font-family: Inter 500, font-size: 13px, color: #78756E, hover: #F0EBE1, letter-spacing: 0.04em
Nav.cta_button: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, font: Inter 600 11px, letter-spacing: 0.08em, text-transform: uppercase, border-radius: 5px, padding: 8px 18px, no border
Nav.mobile_menu: full-screen overlay background #0D0D0D, links stacked at 20px Inter 500, close icon top-right in #E8C97A

Hero.background: autoplay muted looping video with #0D0D0D poster fallback — overlay a dark vignette: linear-gradient(to right, #0D0D0D 45%, transparent 100%) on left, linear-gradient(to top, #0D0D0D 15%, transparent 60%) on bottom
Hero.eyebrow: font: Inter 500 11px, letter-spacing: 0.14em, text-transform: uppercase, color: #E8C97A — content: 'Live Streaming Platform'
Hero.headline: font: Bebas Neue 72–96px, text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: -0.02em, line-height: 1.0, color: #F0EBE1 — highlight keyword in #E8C97A using a <span>
Hero.primary_cta: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, font: Inter 700 13px, text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.08em, border-radius: 5px, padding: 14px 32px
Hero.secondary_cta: border: 1px solid rgba(240,235,225,0.2), color: rgba(240,235,225,0.6), same size as primary, background: transparent
Hero.live_chip: border: 1px solid rgba(93,186,133,0.3), border-radius: 100px, padding: 5px 12px, font: Inter 500 11px, color: #5DBA85 — prepend a 6px pulsing green dot

TrustBar.items: font: Inter 500 11px, letter-spacing: 0.1em, text-transform: uppercase, color: #78756E

ProductReveal.layout: Each feature as a full-width row. Large index number (01 / 02 / 03) in Bebas Neue 80px color #2A2A26 — decorative, top-left of row. Content area has a 2px solid #E8C97A left border. Title: Bebas Neue 32px #F0EBE1. Body: Inter 400 15px #78756E. Icon replaced by index number — remove emoji icons from headings.
ProductReveal.alternation: Odd rows: content left-aligned. Even rows: content right-aligned (mirror layout).

Stats.layout: Full-bleed section, no cards, no borders. Metrics side by side with generous space.
Stats.number: Bebas Neue 72–80px #F0EBE1, animate count up on viewport enter
Stats.label: Inter 500 12px #78756E letter-spacing 0.12em text-transform uppercase, displayed below number

Pricing.section_label: Inter 500 11px #78756E letter-spacing 0.12em uppercase — 'Invest in Better Entertainment'
Pricing.featured_card: border: 1px solid #E8C97A, background: rgba(232,201,122,0.04) — Gold plan only
Pricing.feature_list: Inter 400 12px #78756E, green checkmark icon #5DBA85 before each item
Pricing.cta_default: border: 1px solid #2A2A26, background: transparent, color: rgba(240,235,225,0.6), Inter 600 11px uppercase, border-radius: 5px
Pricing.cta_featured: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, Inter 700 11px uppercase, border-radius: 5px, no border
Pricing.trial_note: Inter 400 11px #3A3A36 centered below cards — '1-day free trial available'

Testimonials.layout: Single column, generous vertical spacing. No card wrapper — open layout.
Testimonials.quote_mark: Bebas Neue 96px color rgba(232,201,122,0.12) — decorative, positioned top-left of quote block
Testimonials.author: Inter 600 13px #F0EBE1 letter-spacing 0.04em
Testimonials.remove: Remove all star rating icons — replace with the decorative oversized quotation mark

LiveMatchTicker.live_badge: background: rgba(93,186,133,0.1), border: 1px solid rgba(93,186,133,0.3), color: #5DBA85, font: Inter 600 9px uppercase letter-spacing 0.1em, border-radius: 3px, padding: 2px 7px — prepend 5px pulsing green dot

FAQ.layout: No card wrapper. Full-width rows separated by 1px solid #2A2A26. No background on rows.
FAQ.question: Inter 500 15px #F0EBE1, padding: 20px 0
FAQ.remove: Remove all card backgrounds and box shadows from FAQ items

FinalCTA.headline: Bebas Neue 64–80px #F0EBE1, line 2 in #E8C97A, text-align center
FinalCTA.cta_button: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, Inter 700 14px uppercase letter-spacing 0.08em, padding: 16px 48px, border-radius: 5px
FinalCTA.sub_text: Inter 400 12px #3A3A36 centered below button — '1-day free trial · Cancel anytime'

auth_page.layout: Two-column split on desktop (50/50). Right panel only on mobile (left panel collapses). Min-height: 100vh. Background: #0D0D0D.

left_panel.signin_tagline: Bebas Neue 48px #F0EBE1 uppercase, line-height 1.0 — e.g. 'Every\nMatch.\nLive.' with 'Live.' in #E8C97A
left_panel.signup_tagline: Bebas Neue 48px #F0EBE1 uppercase — e.g. 'Start\nFor Free.\nWatch Live.' with 'Free.' in #E8C97A
left_panel.signup_checklist: Inter 400 12px #78756E with #5DBA85 ti-check icon before each feature item
left_panel.live_chip: border: 1px solid rgba(93,186,133,0.3), border-radius: 100px, padding: 5px 12px, Inter 500 10px #5DBA85 — prepend 5px pulsing green dot — visible on sign-in panel only

role_toggle.container: display: flex, border: 1px solid #2A2A26, border-radius: 6px, overflow: hidden, margin-bottom: 24px
role_toggle.button_default: flex:1, padding: 9px, Inter 600 10px uppercase letter-spacing 0.08em, color: #78756E, background: transparent, border: none
role_toggle.admin_register: When Admin tab is active: hide registration form, show message 'Admin accounts are created by the platform administrator.' in Inter 400 12px #78756E

right_panel.field_input: background: #161614, border: 1px solid #2A2A26, border-radius: 5px, padding: 10px 14px, font: Inter 400 13px #F0EBE1, outline: none — focus state: border-color: #E8C97A
right_panel.field_error: border-color: #C0392B — error message below field: Inter 400 11px #C0392B, no toast popups
right_panel.submit_button: width: 100%, background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, border: none, border-radius: 5px, padding: 12px, Inter 700 12px uppercase letter-spacing 0.08em, cursor: pointer

admin_dashboard.layout: Two-column: fixed sidebar 200px + fluid main content. Full viewport height. Background: #0D0D0D.

brand_area.admin_badge: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, font: Inter 700 9px uppercase letter-spacing 0.06em, padding: 2px 6px, border-radius: 3px, margin-left: 8px

sidebar.nav_item_default: display: flex align-items: center gap: 8px, padding: 7px 10px, border-radius: 5px, Inter 400 12px #78756E, icon: Tabler outline 14px — no background
sidebar.badge: background: #C0392B, color: #fff, Inter 700 9px, padding: 1px 5px, border-radius: 10px, margin-left: auto — on Email Queue and Chat Threads with unread count

topbar.system_chip: border: 1px solid rgba(93,186,133,0.25), border-radius: 100px, padding: 4px 12px, Inter 500 10px #5DBA85 — prepend 5px green dot
topbar.admin_avatar: 28px circle, background: #2A2A26, border: 1px solid #3A3A36, Inter 600 10px #78756E — initials

stat_cards.card_primary: border-color: rgba(232,201,122,0.3) — use for Total Users card only
stat_cards.label: Inter 500 9px #78756E letter-spacing 0.12em uppercase, margin-bottom: 8px
stat_cards.value: Inter 800 22px #F0EBE1 letter-spacing -0.02em — primary card value in #E8C97A

user_list.row: flex align-center gap:10px, padding: 8px 0, border-bottom: 1px solid #1E1E1A
user_list.name: Inter 400 12px #F0EBE1 flex:1
user_list.plan_badge_platinum: background: rgba(93,186,133,0.1), color: #5DBA85, Inter 600 9px uppercase letter-spacing 0.05em, padding: 2px 7px, border-radius: 3px

email_queue.row: flex align-start gap:10px, padding: 8px 0, border-bottom: 1px solid #1E1E1A
email_queue.subject: Inter 400 12px #F0EBE1 — read: #78756E

launcher_button.unread_badge: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, Inter 700 9px, 16px circle, positioned top-right of button

message_list.user_bubble: background: #E8C97A, color: #0D0D0D, Inter 400 12px, border-radius: 10px 10px 2px 10px, padding: 8px 12px, max-width: 75%
message_list.admin_bubble: background: #2A2A26, color: #F0EBE1, Inter 400 12px, border-radius: 10px 10px 10px 2px, same sizing

input_area.input: background: #161614, border: 1px solid #2A2A26, border-radius: 5px, padding: 8px 12px, Inter 400 12px #F0EBE1 — focus: border-color #E8C97A
input_area.send_button: background: #5DBA85, color: #0D0D0D, border: none, border-radius: 5px, padding: 8px 14px, Inter 600 11px uppercase

panel.error_state: Inter 400 11px #C0392B inline below input — no toast

whatsapp_button.style: Ghost circle — background: transparent, border: 1px solid #2A2A26, width: 48px, height: 48px, border-radius: 50%, display: flex align-items justify-content center
whatsapp_button.tooltip: Inter 400 11px #F0EBE1, background: #2A2A26, border-radius: 4px, padding: 4px 8px — 'Chat with us' — appears on hover
whatsapp_button.note: Do NOT use the standard green WhatsApp floating button style. Understated ghost button only.

constraints: DO NOT change any component logic, props, state, hooks, or event handlers
DO NOT change any API endpoint calls or socket.io event names
DO NOT change any routing configuration or auth flow behavior
DO NOT change any data models or backend code
DO NOT change any content, copy, labels, or placeholder text
DO NOT change any accessibility attributes (aria-*, role, tabIndex) already present
DO NOT add new npm packages — only Google Fonts via @import in CSS
ONLY modify CSS classes, Tailwind utility classes, inline styles, and src/index.css
Keep all existing component file names and folder structure intact
Admin registration disabled state is already implemented — only restyle the messaging text, do not change the logic
implementation_order: 1. Add font @import and CSS variables to src/index.css
2. Remove old color variables and font references from index.css
5. Restyle TrustBar, ProductReveal, HowItWorks, Stats in sequence
7. Restyle Testimonials, LiveMatchTicker, FAQ, FinalCTA, Footer
8. Restyle AuthPage (both sign-in and sign-up states)
10. Restyle admin stat cards, panels, user list, email queue, analytics table
